terminology.decision: 'certified' means guaranteed bounds and does not fit; use 'numerically verified' with a 'numerical verification error' (estimate U)
terminology.implementation: user-facing text of logs, run reports, index and new reports; internal keys (final == 'CERTIFIED', certified_info) are kept for reproducibility and mean 'numerically verified'

Q1_assumed_inputs.decision: QoI-dependent tolerances: a person is asked only when an assumed input changes a numerically verified quantity by more than the adopted accuracy target of that QoI class
Q1_assumed_inputs.implementation: autonomous step A uses sensitivity's accuracy-target decision (was the post hoc proposal)

Q2_earlier_estimates.decision: retained if later refinements meet round-off, provided no contradictory evidence appears and the limitations are recorded
Q2_earlier_estimates.implementation: a later state that no longer verifies a quantity keeps the earlier estimate only if its cross-check is not contradicted and its value lies within the combined uncertainty of the earlier estimate; the limitation is recorded; otherwise the earlier estimate is withdrawn

Q3_rules.R2: not adopted as a general rule (problem and goal dependent; e.g. for neural operators geometry generalization is key): a passing reference-domain check is recorded as supporting evidence only and does not replace the production check

Q4_groove.decision: levels 7-9 not computed; the groove peak is reported as numerically unverified
